visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a white t-shirt and blue jeans enters a brightly lit bedroom carrying a plate with scrambled eggs and toast. He smiles at the camera and the woman lying in bed. (2) The scene cuts to the man vacuuming a living room with a purple upright vacuum. The background features a white sofa, a modern rug, and a large painting of a landscape. (3) The man sits on the floor folding baby-sized striped clothes next to a laundry basket. The room is tidy with bookshelves and plants in the background. (4) The man is in a kitchen assisting a woman who is using crutches. He holds her arm to stabilize her as she stands up. (5) Back in the bedroom, the man presents a large black and teal pack of Pampers Luxury Silk diapers to the camera with a proud expression. (6) Close-up shots show the details of the diaper, including the soft texture, the patterned waistband, and a stack of diapers being handled. The woman in bed is seen holding the product and smiling. (7) The video concludes with the man giving a thumbs-up to the camera while the woman holds a diaper to her cheek in the background, appearing happy and relaxed.
